en: The image shows a black-and-white postcard featuring a large, historic stone church with a prominent clock tower and a steeply pitched roof. In the foreground, there is a lush park with benches and a picturesque gazebo. Several people in period clothing, including women in long dresses and hats, are gathered in the park area. The style is distinctly early 20th century. There is handwritten text across the bottom of the postcard, and printed text with place names and what appears to be publisher information.
